visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with long dark hair, wearing a vibrant red dress and a black cardigan, stands on a stage holding a microphone. Beside her, a man in a bright green suit jacket plays an electronic keyboard. They are positioned in front of a large yellow and white banner featuring Chinese characters and a cartoon rabbit. The lighting is bright and indoor. (2) The camera cuts to a medium shot of a man with short, styled hair wearing a light blue striped shirt. He is singing with intense facial expressions, squinting his eyes and holding his hands to his chest, then reaching out toward the camera. Behind him, other people are visible, including a man in a black shirt clapping. (3) The scene shifts to a series of close-up shots showing various gift products. There are boxes of face masks, sets of coffee packets in yellow packaging, and colorful boxes with floral patterns arranged on a red tablecloth. The background is a blurred indoor event space with shelves and signs. (4) A woman in a dark uniform and a face mask walks through a crowd while holding a large circular sign. The man in the light blue shirt follows her, holding a red rectangular sign and a red gift box, smiling and posing for the audience. The audience consists of people seated in chairs, some of whom are filming with phones. (5) A close-up shows the man in the light blue shirt writing on a small wooden heart-shaped tag with a black marker. He then hangs the tag onto a wooden rack filled with similar tags, which is labeled as a 'Wishing Wall' in Chinese. He gestures with a peace sign towards the camera, smiling. (6) The video concludes with a large group of people gathered on the stage. They are holding various products, signs, and banners, smiling and waving at the camera. The man in the blue shirt is among them. The setting remains the indoor event hall with bright, flat lighting and a high-energy atmosphere.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 第一天 我存在. [Slogan]: 115年度 臺北市庇護工場 春節產品行銷暨減重大作戰頒獎活動. (2) [Subtitle]: 第一次 呼吸暢快. (3) [Subtitle]: 站在地上的腳踝. (4) [Subtitle]: 因為你而有真實感. (5) [Subtitle]: 今天來到 臺北市庇護工場 春節產品行銷記者會 跟著庇護職人 一起走秀. (6) [Subtitle]: 每一項產品 都是他們親手製作的 超級用心的. (7) [Variety]: (走秀中). [Subtitle]: 馬偕喜樂工作坊 所帶的喜樂綜合禮盒 選自100% 阿拉比卡有機公平貿易豆. [Slogan]: 喜禮滿載. (8) [Variety]: (填寫祈願卡). [Subtitle]: 這個是一個 祈願的板板 就是祝福大家 新的一年都可以 完成板子上的願望. (9) [Variety]: (寫好心願了). [Slogan]: 萬事如意. (10) [Variety]: (綁上祈願牆). [Subtitle]: 在即將到來的春節 邀請大家 一同上 微笑商城網 挑選禮品. (11) [Subtitle]: 即日起到2026/2/28前 只要是微笑會員 都可以抽到商品券 (60元*2張商品券). (12) [Subtitle]: 讓大家可以用 最優惠的價格 買到最好的伴手禮 省時便利又能夠用行動支持他們 讓我們一起 把愛傳出去吧.
